translations.web: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
translations.bsb: Discipline is harsh for him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.
translations.kjv: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
translations.asv: There is grievous correction for him that forsaketh the way; And he that hateth reproof shall die.
